{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Remove rows with invalid ages (negative or > 120)
valid_sales_df = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_age'] >= 0) & (sales_df['customer_age'] <= 120)]

# Compute the mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_sales_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding invalid entries): {mean_age}')"}
